description: Use this when a vibescape should be listed in the public gallery, where anybody can find it at vibresia.com/vibescapes. A vibescape is created unlisted; this is the separate act of putting it in front of people. The name and the author go with it, so make sure they are right before calling this. Only the vibescape's own capability can list it: pass the `editKey` that `create_vibescape` returned, together with the id. A vibescape made somewhere else — in the app, say — has a capability too, but only the person who made it holds it, so it cannot be listed from here.

editKey.description: The capability that came with the vibescape, if it has one. `create_vibescape` returns it as `editKey`; a vibescape made by somebody else has a capability you do not hold, and it cannot be listed from here — say so rather than pretending.

id.description: The share's id — the last part of the link, six characters. It is what `create_vibescape` returns.

name: share_vibescape
title: Share a vibescape
